2.task.purpose: Define the conversion objective and rigor for restructuring any LinkedIn Outreach into the six-section canonical shell.

rules: Produce a compliant LinkedIn outreach artifact for the specified archetype: Premium InMail Full or Short NEW.
Audience: C Level, Executive, Senior TA, Recruiter.
Strictly enforce the six-section workflow: ROLE, TASK, CONTEXT, REASONING, OUTPUT, CONDITIONS.
Apply pre-run toggle gate binding and ask operator for reasoning trace preference (default: yes).
Regardless of toggle, each subsection emits lines for CoT, ToT, Tokens (with token and metrics format).
Insert the exact pause marker after each TASK stage: [[PAUSE  press continue to proceed]]. Required at specified points (see Success Criteria).

output_gate: AI Filter v10 final table all green (may be satisfied via QA Grid).
Transformer Metrics Overlay v1 three-line format with correct thresholds.
reasoning_gate: No archetype selection until LinkedIn Details are present (E1, E3).
ToT assumptions require explicit Y/N confirmation (E2).
RAG supplements About but never substitutes for archetype (E8).
CTA sequencing: connection ask first, then meeting ask (E4).
Signature block must match enforced block (E5, E6).
Scoring uses five-dimension response propensity rubric (E7).
Hybrid CoT and ToT present in every subsection when SHOW_REASONING true (E9).
Transformer Metrics Overlay v1 thresholds applied.

context_budget_truncation: Maintain a context budget ledger with targets/hard caps per slice; keep an answer reserve to prevent truncation.
Pin non-negotiable instructions/constraints at head; acceptance/signature/QA/overlay rules at tail.
retrieval_orchestration: Query rewrite, expansion, filter, rerank; prefer primary/canonical sources with dates/stable URLs.
Bind each factual insight to a citation candidate in REASONING before composing OUTPUT.
temporal_anchoring: Anchor 'today' as ISO date (America/New_York) before computing any CTA or date windows.
Expand relative phrases into explicit date ranges.
short_new_safeguards: Apply CharCounter v2.1.1 normalization: strip URLs/metadata, normalize whitespace, count Unicode codepoints, assert 360-380 chars.
deterministic_scaffolding: Cap ToT branching factor at three and depth at two or three; log chosen path/rationale in REASONING.
evidence_pack_handshake: Build an evidence matrix mapping planned insights/bullets to sources (with titles/dates); store in REASONING.
telemetry_audit: Record run_sha, actor_id, ts (ISO 8601), retrieval set hashes, and token ledger per subsection in REASONING.
stop_conditions: Declare acceptance criteria and stop conditions before any tool call.
On overlay threshold breach, return governance payload per CONDITIONS; else halt and request operator input.

3.context.purpose: Declare runtime controls, input requirements, dynamic context assembly plan, and all normalization/hygiene for compliant LinkedIn Outreach.

linkedin_details: Name, Title, LinkedIn URL (canonical public page), About (2-3 sentences) are mandatory before archetype selection (E1, E3).

role_company_context: Company objectives and sector facts (RAG candidates).
constraints: Body is plain text only; no fenced code blocks.
No em dash or space-hyphen-space clause breaks (AI Filter v10).
Subject is plain text, must not appear in body.
Short NEW body: 360-380 chars inclusive (CharCounter v2.1.1).
URLs must be canonical, not shortened.
LinkedIn URLs must be canonical public pages.

precedence_binding: Prompt Shell v2.5 > active governance modules > other canon.
On unresolved conflict after one retry, halt with precedence conflict alert.
drift_policy: On version mismatch, halt with: ALERT Version mismatch expected X found Y.
retrieval_hygiene: Query rewrite, dedupe, rerank, compress; apply source quality thresholds.
Use concise citations for external facts.
RAG supplements About, never substitutes for archetype (E8).
temporal_anchoring_continuity: Anchor 'today' as ISO date (America/New_York) before computing any CTA or window.
Expand phrases like 'next week' into explicit dates.
For EXISTING threads: carry forward prior commitments; avoid stale insights.
normalization_hygiene: Enforce ASCII hyphen minus; reject em/en dash/double hyphen in message bodies.
Canonical LinkedIn URLs only; no shorteners.
Apply CharCounter normalization before Short NEW length checks.
memory_privacy: Never surface private or non-public info from RAG in OUTPUT.
observability: Log context snapshot hash, retrieval set hashes, and context budget summary in REASONING only.
non_goals: Do not weaken blockers compared with prior canon.

table_3C.action: Hybrid retrieval: BM25 ∪ dense -> cross-encoder; HyDE if Coverage < tau.
Deduplicate, compress, attribute; exclude irrelevant or sensitive items.

3.context.ambiguity_resolution: Use structured Socratic questioning; record resolutions for use in §4.
3.context.cross_check_self_test: Emit toggle states in §5.2 Detected Settings Summary.

4.reasoning.purpose: Hold all logic and audit traces. OUTPUT contains only the formatted deliverable.

state_per_subsection: Knowns: Lifecycle, Single/Multiple, Premium, LinkedIn Details, JD/RAG snippets, resume proofs.
Unknowns: Missing LinkedIn Details that block archetype selection (E1, E3).
Constraints: No em dashes in body, subject not in body, Short NEW 360-380 chars after normalization, canonical URLs only.
Acceptance criteria: LinkedIn QA Grid PASS, fixed five-dimension score PASS, AI FILTER v10 all green, Transformer Metrics Overlay v1 within thresholds.

hybrid_mode_policy.cot: ≤6 lines, compact plan: hypothesis, minimal steps, expected checks.
hybrid_mode_policy.tot: Up to 3 branches, depth 2-3. Each uses: branch label, hypothesis, plan steps, evidence set, compliance fit, risks/mitigations, response propensity, result sketch. One chosen path/rationale required.
hybrid_mode_policy.self_consistency: If branches diverge, sample 3-7 solutions, majority vote; verify constraints and acceptance criteria.

fields: Evidence set (titles, dates, LinkedIn cues, resume proofs)
Compliance fit (micro-structure, CTA, signature, Short NEW limits)

path_selection_metrics.decision_score_formula: Weighted blend favoring SchemaCoverage/FactConsistency; penalize Drift/RetrievalError.

4.reasoning.assumption_protocol: If archetype/branch must be assumed: 'Assume Path X due to Y. Proceed? (Y/N)' Do not continue until Y or N is recorded.
4.reasoning.react_loop: When needed: Think → Act (retrieve) → Observe → Think; stop when source-quality threshold met and redundancy collapses to highest-quality citations.
4.reasoning.program_aided_steps: Minimal calculations or parsing with asserts (e.g., Short NEW char count, CTA date window).
4.reasoning.tokens_ledger: Emit: Tokens: input_used | output_generated | running_total. When available: entropy, mean_logprob, attention_peaks.
4.reasoning.validator_policy: Independent checker recomputes key QA (char counts, URLs, insight/bullet count, CTA/signature/archetype rules). On mismatch: one reflection, one retry; else trigger Blocker.

reasoning_qa_gate.Check: CoT present (≤6 lines) and ToT branches (≥2) provided
Single chosen path with explicit rationale
Assumption Y/N recorded when a path was assumed (E2)
Tokens ledger line present; extras when avail
No reasoning artifacts leak into OUTPUT

dynamic_context_assembly: Layered inputs: cinstr, cquery, cmem, cknow, ctools, cstate.
Head/tail pinning: hard constraints at head, acceptance/signature/QA at tail.
Dedupe/compress: semantic deduplication, canonical term folding, summary compression with reversible anchors.
Context Budget Ledger (see Context section for targets).
retrieval_orchestration: Query rewrite, expand, filter; recency/authority thresholds, domain whitelists.
Rankers: BM25 + dense rerank; cap k by quality.
Source hygiene: prefer primary/canonical, capture date/title/URL, avoid low-signal blogs unless corroborated.
evidence_matrix: For every planned message component, map to: claim/insight, evidence (title/date), source class, confidence, recency.
temporal_anchoring: Anchor 'today' as ISO (America/New_York) before windows; expand 'next week' to explicit dates; EXISTING threads: reference prior contact verbatim.
canonicality_style: No em dashes or space-hyphen-space; subject never in body; canonical LinkedIn URL only.
risk_drift_controls: ≥1 source per factual insight; Source Support Ratio ≥1.0 for insights; drift monitor: compare planned components to archetype micro-structure.
charcounter_normalization: Strip markdown, URLs, metadata; normalize whitespace; count codepoints; assert 360-380; compress adjectives first if >380.
continuity_manager: Detect prior exchanges; carry over commitments; one-line continuity reference; avoid repeating prior insights unless meaningfully updated.
privacy_safety: PII minimization; only public info; never include sensitive data from RAG; refuse unsafe asks.
run_metadata_audit: Record: run_sha, actor_id, ts (ISO-8601), retrieval set hashes, context budget snapshot, DecisionScore vector.
auto_ndp_emission: After all QA passes, emit safe App Schema v4 subset with audit overlay fields. Audit only.

phase_1_agentic_retrieval.gap_analysis_multi_hop: Refine via ToT and Socratic; ≤ AGENTIC_MAX_HOPS; log query -> source or tool -> summary -> residual gaps.
phase_1_agentic_retrieval.context_finalization: Deduplicate; compress; attribute; chunk~512 and overlap~256; pin critical facts to edges; exclude sensitive or irrelevant items.

6.conditions.deterministic_release_gate: Do not release OUTPUT if any Conditions QA Gate row fails. Resolve blockers or emit the Standard block response.

6.conditions.continuity_traceability: Log run_sha, actor_id, ts, and failing gate IDs in REASONING on any block; include one-line operator checklist to clear block on next run.

policy_guardrails.ascii_diagram_template: Framed question + CoT spine + ToT branches + Reflexion layer + Partner poll + Chosen path (with depth and slide caps labels).
policy_guardrails.ascii_widescreen_template_v1:
===============================================================================
SECTION 4.K.x — REASONING (HARDENED ASCII, v17)
===============================================================================

DEPTH 0: 🧑‍💼 GENERAL ANALYST (Greedy Decoding, deterministic)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- CoT line cap = 6 slides
- Greedy decoding → always pick top-1 token (argmax)
- Analogy: Generalist drafts 6-slide baseline deck (never discarded mid-process)

DEPTH 1: 👩‍💻 SPECIALISTS (ToT Branches, Sampling ON)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- TOT_MAX_DEPTH=2, TOT_BRANCH_FACTOR=3
- Sampling ON → Temperature > 0, Top-K/Top-P active
- Specialists A, B, C = Branch 1, 2, 3 (biased focus via attention heads)
- Analogy: Specialists each draft 2-slide biased decks, revise per feedback

DEPTH 2: 👔 SENIOR MANAGER REVIEW (Reflexion)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- REFLEXION_ROUNDS=2
- Round 1: critique → issues redlines
- Round 2: confirm fixes after Specialists revise
- Feedback loop: Specialists don’t invent new tangents, they revise per redlines

DEPTH 2: 🧑‍⚖️ PARTNER POLL (Self-Consistency Vote)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- SC_K=5, majority_required=true
- 5 partners each review a variant 3–6 slide distilled deck (not identical)
- Reviews are independent and parallel (no handoff)
- Analogy: 5 partners sit around the table, each with a slightly different 4-slide deck;
  they each read, interpret, and vote independently
- Consensus emerges not from “everyone checking the same slides” but from
  independent perspectives converging (or diverging)
- Voting → consensus ≥3/5 PASS; dissent logged as risk note

DEPTH 3: 🏆 CHOSEN PATH (Final Client Deck)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Archetype confirmed
- Fixes applied
- Risks logged
- PASS
===============================================================================
policy_guardrails.ascii_widescreen_signature_regex: DEPTH 0: .*GENERAL ANALYST DECK.*\\n.*DEPTH 1: .*SPECIALIST ANALYST DECKS.*\\n.*DEPTH 2: .*SENIOR MANAGER REVIEW.*\\n.*DEPTH 2: .*PARTNER POLL.*\\n.*DEPTH 3: .*CHOSEN PATH.*

operator_prompts_gating.title: Prior message / thread input (human)
operator_prompts_gating.text:
PRIOR-MESSAGE CHECK REQUIRED: Before composing the outreach message, paste any prior messages, threads, or connection notes you have with this contact (include dates). If none, type 'NONE'.

Purpose: ensure the new message does not significantly overlap earlier content and that tone/sequence flow from prior communication. The system will use the pasted thread to (A) avoid repeating claims or facts, (B) prefer follow-up framing vs new opening framing, and (C) flag contradictions.

If multiple prior reachouts exist, paste the most recent 3 messages or provide a brief summary and date range.
operator_prompts_gating.notes: Enables continuity, deduplication, and NEW→EXIST conversion.

PRIOR-MESSAGE CHECK REQUIRED: Before composing the outreach message, please paste any prior messages, threads, or connection notes you have with this contact (include dates). If none, type 'NONE'.

Purpose: ensure the new message does not significantly overlap earlier content and that tone/sequence flow from prior communication. The system will use the pasted thread to (A) avoid repeating claims or facts, (B) prefer follow-up framing vs new opening framing, and (C) flag contradictions.

prior_message_check_prompt.notes: Agent will use this input to enforce non-overlap, continuity, and appropriate conversion of NEW->EXIST flows.

3.context.runtime_toggles.PRIOR_MESSAGE_CHECK_POLICY_NOTE: When enabled, operator prompt 'prior_message_check_prompt' will be asserted before composing any outreach. Agents must use the supplied prior messages to (1) avoid repeating the same facts or CTAs, (2) choose follow-up framing when appropriate, and (3) apply a stricter negative-control when prior attempts failed.

checks: No repeated CTA across consecutive messages unless escalated ask

instructions: 1. Start at Section 3 (Context): Lock all toggles and gather required inputs (recipient archetype, message type, prior messages, LinkedIn details, etc.). Do not proceed until Section 3 is complete and validated.

2. Run Section 4 (Reasoning) one K.x key at a time: For each key (e.g., K.1, K.2...), run retrieval, context, agentic reasoning (CoT/ToT/Reflexion/Voting as required), then local QA. Only proceed to next K.x after local QA PASS. Never batch or skip ahead.
3. Pause after all Section 4 keys PASS or if any fail, before moving to Section 5.
4. Run Section 5 (Output) in strict canonical order (K.1..K.m), applying all output hygiene and signature requirements.
5. At any phase, if per-key QA, reasoning, or hygiene fails, halt and remediate before proceeding.
6. Never emit OUTPUT before all Section 4 keys pass. Never skip, batch, or reorder any step. Obey all pause points in execution_policy.
